description: Defines the QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter class for converting sent QUIC frames to connection byte offsets, including related data structures and methods.

classes.name: QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter
classes.description: Converts sent QUIC frames to connection byte offsets, maintaining stream segments and control frame info.

classes.name: StreamOffsetSegment
classes.description: Represents a range of stream offset with contiguous connection offset.

classes.name: StreamInfo
classes.description: Stores information about stream segments and whether fin has been sent.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameSent
methods.description: Handles sent crypto frames, returning connection offsets.

methods.name: OnStreamFrameSent
methods.description: Handles sent stream frames, returning connection offsets.

methods.name: OnControlFrameSent
methods.description: Handles sent control frames, returning connection offsets.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Updates stream info when a frame is sent and returns connection offsets.
